stdout:
Add a playlist item. Use this tool to add a playlist item to a playlist.

Usage:
  yutu playlistItem insert [flags]

Examples:
# Add a video to a playlist
yutu playlistItem insert --kind video --playlistId PLxxx --channelId UC_x5X --kVideoId dQw4w9WgXcQ
# Add a video to a playlist with privacy setting
yutu playlistItem insert --kind video --playlistId PLxxx --channelId UC_x5X --kVideoId dQw4w9 --privacy public

Flags:
  -c, --channelId string                ID that YouTube uses to uniquely identify the user that added the item to the playlist
  -d, --description string              Description of the playlist item
  -h, --help                            help for insert
  -C, --kChannelId string               ID of the channel if kind is channel
  -Y, --kPlaylistId string              ID of the playlist if kind is playlist
  -V, --kVideoId string                 ID of the video if kind is video
  -k, --kind string                     video|channel|playlist
  -b, --onBehalfOfContentOwner string   ID of the content owner, for YouTube content partners
  -o, --output string                   json|yaml|silent
  -y, --playlistId string               The id that YouTube uses to uniquely identify the playlist that the item is in
  -p, --privacy string                  public|private|unlisted
  -t, --title string                    Title of the playlist item
      --yes                             Confirm the operation
